name: Onmyouji Aya
source:
Aya - a Japanese esoteric cosmologist, living in this modern time.
An evil hand tries to reach this voluptuous, smart and talented beauty.

Aya, her body is twitched and her groin so wet, she tries to resist.

Can she endure this demon's erosion!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051803.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
绫 - 一位生活在现代的日本深奥宇宙学家。
一只邪恶的手试图接近这位性感、聪明、才华横溢的美女。

阿雅，她的身体抽搐着，腹股沟湿漉漉的，她试图反抗。

她能承受这个恶魔的侵蚀吗！？
